observations.why: Quinton performs a unilateral adoption decision as a declarative — enacting authority-ranking by announcing a binding organizational choice without consultation framing.
Performance framed as proportional cost-benefit comparison — market-pricing enacted through quantified ROI justification for the adoption decision.
Commissive act committing the organization to a timeline — authority-ranking enacted by a single speaker binding collective action to a schedule.
Note-taker ratifies the adoption as a settled decision — authority-ranking enacted by recording a unilateral choice as organizational record.
Performance metric restated as proportional gain — market-pricing enacted by quantifying benefit as the justification frame.
Timeline recorded as a committed organizational milestone — authority-ranking enacted by inscribing a binding schedule into the record.
